test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V, each has a different height. P is taller than only U and R. R is taller than U. Q is taller than S but shorter than T. T is not the tallest among all. The height of how many people is between the heights of Q and R?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) P is taller than **only** U and R 

⇒ **P** > U and R 

2) R is taller than U 

⇒ P > **R** > U

3) Q is taller than S but shorter than T 

⇒ T > **Q** > S

4) T is not the tallest among all 

So, the correct order will be ⇒ V > T > Q > S > P > R > U 

So, there are two persons between Q and R.

Hence, the option 3 is the correct answer.
